title: Server Overloaded!
description: Your servers are buckling under traffic. Response times are spiking and users are seeing errors.

choices.description: Add more server capacity to handle the traffic spike.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash now, but protects stability and reputation.

choices.description: Cache expensive queries to reduce database pressure.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and adds tech debt, but reduces ongoing infra pressure.

choices.description: Preserve cash and hope the traffic subsides.
choices.tradeOff: Saves cash, but stability and reputation will degrade over time.

title: Slow Database
description: Queries are taking seconds to complete. Your database is struggling with the load.

choices.description: Rewrite slow queries and add proper indexes.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but takes time and reduces tech debt.

choices.description: Distribute read load across multiple database instances.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and adds ongoing infra expense, but dramatically improves stability.

choices.description: Users will have to wait. Maybe it resolves itself.
choices.tradeOff: Saves cash, but stability and reputation will keep degrading.

title: Disk Space Critical
description: Your disk is almost full. New data can't be written and backups are failing.

choices.description: Immediately expand disk capacity to restore operations.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and adds ongoing expense, but fixes the immediate crisis.

choices.description: Delete logs and unused data to free space quickly.
choices.tradeOff: Quick fix, but adds tech debt and risks data loss.

choices.description: Hope the disk fills up slowly enough to handle later.
choices.tradeOff: Saves cash, but system will become increasingly unstable.

modifiers.label: Disk Space Critical
modifiers.description: System instability due to full disk.

title: Caching Opportunity
description: Your database is handling repeated queries from thousands of users. This is increasing infrastructure pressure.

choices.description: Deploy a scalable cache layer for repeated database queries.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and adds tech debt, but reduces ongoing infra pressure.

modifiers.label: Redis Cache Layer
modifiers.description: Reduces repeated database pressure at scale.

choices.description: Quick app-layer caching. Cheap, but fragile.
choices.tradeOff: Quick fix with no cash cost, but adds tech debt and is temporary.

modifiers.label: Temporary Cache Patch
modifiers.description: Quick app-layer caching. Fragile and temporary.

choices.description: Preserve cash and avoid technical changes.
choices.tradeOff: Saves cash, but database pressure will continue to grow.

modifiers.label: Ignored Cache Pressure
modifiers.description: Database pressure continues to grow without mitigation.

title: Global Distribution
description: Users worldwide are complaining about slow load times. A CDN would help distribute content globally.

choices.description: Deploy global content delivery to reduce latency worldwide.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and adds ongoing expense, but improves global performance and reputation.

choices.description: Compress and optimize existing assets without new infrastructure.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but limited improvement. Adds tech debt.

choices.description: International users will have to deal with latency.
choices.tradeOff: Saves cash, but reputation will keep degrading from poor global experience.

title: Tweet Went Viral!
description: A popular developer just tweeted about your product. Traffic is surging!

choices.description: Launch a landing page and capture the incoming traffic.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but maximizes user capture from viral moment.

choices.description: Engage with new visitors and convert them to active users.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but stability may suffer from rapid engagement.

choices.description: Don't chase viral moments. Focus on the product.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but misses a growth opportunity.

title: Product Hunt Launch Window
description: Your product can launch today, but the result depends on preparation and product quality.

choices.description: Invest in a polished launch with demo, screenshots, and community prep.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but maximizes launch impact and reputation.

choices.description: Ship what you have and hope for the best.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but higher risk of negative reception.

choices.description: Wait for a better time to launch.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but loses momentum and hype.

title: Hacker News Spike
description: Your post is gaining traction. Traffic is coming whether you are ready or not.

choices.description: Quickly upgrade infrastructure to handle the incoming traffic.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and adds ongoing expense, but prevents crashes during peak.

choices.description: Don't spend money. Hope the traffic converts naturally.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but high variance. Can succeed or overload the product.

choices.description: Reduce load by disabling non-essential features during the spike.
choices.tradeOff: Protects stability, but reduces conversion and user experience.

title: Influencer Offer
description: A creator wants to promote your SaaS to a large audience.

choices.description: Pay upfront for guaranteed reach and placement.
choices.tradeOff: High cash cost, but reliable reach and reputation boost.

choices.description: Pay based on results. Lower upfront cost, lower guaranteed reach.
choices.tradeOff: Lower risk, but less control over results.

choices.description: Pass on the opportunity.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but misses a growth opportunity.

title: Community Buzz
description: Developers are talking about your product on Reddit and forums.

choices.description: Join the discussion and answer questions directly.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but takes time and effort.

choices.description: Share a technical deep-dive to build credibility.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but takes time to create content.

choices.description: Let the buzz fade naturally.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but misses community engagement opportunity.

title: Dark Mode Request
description: Users are requesting dark mode. It's the most upvoted feature request.

choices.description: Implement a proper dark mode with system preference detection.
choices.tradeOff: Builds reputation and hype, but adds tech debt.

choices.description: Acknowledge the request but prioritize other work.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but reputation drops from ignored request.

choices.description: Quick CSS toggle without proper testing.
choices.tradeOff: Quick reputation boost, but high tech debt and bug risk.

title: Most Requested Feature
description: Users have been asking for this feature for months. It's time to build it.

choices.description: Invest time in a well-tested, polished implementation.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but builds strong reputation and reduces tech debt.

choices.description: Ship a basic version quickly to show progress.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but adds tech debt from quick implementation.

choices.description: Focus on other priorities.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but reputation drops significantly from ignored users.

modifiers.label: Ignored Feature Request
modifiers.description: Users are frustrated by lack of requested features.

title: Negative Reviews
description: Users are leaving negative reviews. They're frustrated with performance and bugs.

choices.description: Dedicate a sprint to squash every reported bug.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but rebuilds reputation and stability.

choices.description: Give affected users a free month to retain them.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but retains users and rebuilds some reputation.

choices.description: Reviews will blow over. Focus on growth.
choices.tradeOff: Saves cash, but reputation and user count will keep dropping.

modifiers.label: Negative Review Backlash
modifiers.description: Poor reviews continue to deter new users.

title: Critical Bug Found
description: A critical bug is causing data loss for some users. This needs immediate attention.

choices.description: Drop everything and patch the bug immediately.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but quickly restores stability and reputation.

choices.description: Find the root cause and fix it properly.
choices.tradeOff: Costs more cash and time, but reduces future bug risk.

choices.description: Apply a temporary workaround without full testing.
choices.tradeOff: Quick fix, but adds tech debt and increases future bug risk.

title: Technical Debt Crisis
description: The codebase is getting unwieldy. New features are taking twice as long to implement.

choices.description: Pause features and clean up the codebase.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and time, but dramatically improves long-term health.

choices.description: Clean up code as you build new features.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but slower improvement than a dedicated sprint.

choices.description: Technical debt can wait. Users want features.
choices.tradeOff: Quick hype boost, but tech debt will keep growing and hurt stability.

title: Investor Interest
description: A venture capitalist has noticed your growth. They want to discuss an investment.

choices.description: Present your metrics and growth story.
choices.tradeOff: No cost, but you're committing to investor expectations.

choices.description: Push for a higher valuation before committing.
choices.tradeOff: More cash, but some reputation loss from being aggressive.

choices.description: Decline funding and stay independent.
choices.tradeOff: No cash, but builds strong brand reputation and community loyalty.

modifiers.label: Bootstrapped Pride
modifiers.description: The indie hacker community respects your independence.

title: Competitor Launched
description: A well-funded competitor just launched a similar product. Some users are considering switching.

choices.description: Build unique features the competitor doesn't have.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash, but builds reputation and hype through innovation.

choices.description: Lower prices to undercut the competitor.
choices.tradeOff: Costs cash and reduces revenue, but gains users at reputation cost.

choices.description: Double down on community and open source values.
choices.tradeOff: No cash cost, but builds long-term loyalty and reputation.

modifiers.label: Community Loyalty
modifiers.description: Your community becomes more engaged and vocal.
